claims.claim: requires minimum effort and within a few strokes air gets inflated
claims.evidence: No video or test clip showing pump in use; static photo cannot show ease of operation or stroke count.
No weight shown or stated material confirmed in photo; claim is cut off and unproven by image.

risks.risk: Internal seals/valve may not hold pressure, pump could be non-functional
risks.proof: Short video of pump being used to inflate a ball or tire showing air flow and pressure holding

risks.risk: Missing original accessories (extra needles, nozzle tips)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as base unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Hidden wear, cracks, or damage on barrel or hose
risks.proof: Close-up photos of full pump body, hose, and handle from multiple angles

risks.risk: Unknown age or usage history affecting lifespan
risks.proof: Purchase receipt, box with date, or seller statement on usage duration

proof_requests: Video of the pump actively inflating something, showing stroke effort and air delivery
Clear close-up photos of the full pump body, hose, and valve nozzle for wear/cracks
Photo of all accessories/nozzles included with the pump
Any proof of purchase date or usage history
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a hand/ball air pump, so it can be priced at worst case pending functional and condition proof.
